title: Hearthstone Scheduling Commitment for In-Place Home Resale Inspections
content:
**Hearthstone's scheduling commitment.** On an In-Place Home Resale package whose inspection fee is above 0.00, what the initial inspection charge bills follows the calendar days from the file's opening date to the inspection date, Hearthstone standing behind its scheduling commitment:

- an inspection held more than 14 days after opening is not charged at all, so no inspection charge is posted for it;
- an inspection held more than 7 but no more than 14 days after opening has the package's inspection fee waived and is charged the inspection additions alone;
- an inspection held no more than 7 days after opening is charged the package's inspection fee plus the inspection additions.

The charge so decided is rounded half up to the cent only at that final step.

**Terms.** The *days after opening* are the inspection date (the record date of the initial inspection) less the file's opening date, in calendar days. The *inspection additions* are the additions the initial inspection charge carries for the home and its file, added together; where none applies they are 0.00.

| Days from opening to inspection | Billed |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | package's inspection fee plus the inspection additions |
| 8 to 14 | the inspection additions alone |
| 15 or more | nothing; no charge is posted |

## Worked figures (hypothetical file: opened 2 March, package inspection fee 125.00, inspection additions 70.00)

| Inspected on | Days after opening | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 9 March | 7 | 125.00 plus 70.00, 195.00 |
| 10 March | 8 | 70.00 |
| 16 March | 14 | 70.00 |
| 17 March | 15 | none posted |
